name: Dale Fournier
bio: Clinical Assistant Professor of Physical Therapy at Clarkson, trained entirely at Western University in Canada (BSc Kinesiology, MPT, MSc Anatomy & Cell Biology, PhD Health & Rehabilitation Sciences). His research centers on spine health — particularly diffuse idiopathic skeletal hyperostosis (DISH) — and using medical imaging to guide clinical decisions; he teaches anatomy and physiology and the PT research series.
